controls.name: reference
controls.description: Drop peaks in blacklisted regions and on non-standard chromosomes, then count peak overlaps in each direction.

controls.name: blacklist_only
controls.description: Drop blacklisted peaks but keep unplaced and mitochondrial contigs.

controls.name: book_ended_counts
controls.description: Treat coordinates as 1-based closed, so touching intervals count as overlapping.

controls.name: encode_filtered_too
controls.description: Apply the same filter to the ENCODE set before computing recovery.

controls.name: no_artifact_filter
controls.description: Compare the peak file as delivered, blacklisted regions included.

controls.name: swapped_denominators
controls.description: Report the two fractions against the wrong denominators.

controls.name: basepair_overlap
controls.description: Report base-pair overlap instead of the share of peaks.

controls.name: reference
controls.description: Rank ENCODE peaks by ENCODE q-value and compute recovery in the top and bottom tenth.

controls.name: rank_by_signal_value
controls.description: Rank ENCODE peaks by signalValue (column 7) instead of q-value.

controls.name: rank_by_p_value
controls.description: Rank ENCODE peaks by p-value (column 8).

controls.name: unfiltered_peaks
controls.description: Use the CUT&Tag peaks as delivered.

controls.name: decile_rounded_up
controls.description: Take ceil(n/10) peaks per decile.

controls.name: uniform_recovery_assumed
controls.description: Report the overall recovery for both strata, with no stratification.

controls.name: stratified_wrong_peak_set
controls.description: Stratify the CUT&Tag peaks by their own q-value and report their overlap with ENCODE.

controls.name: absence_read_as_absent
controls.description: Correct numbers, but concludes the mark is absent where no peak was called.

controls.name: reference
controls.description: Filter each peak set, compute the share of peaks in ENCODE, isolate MACS2 peaks that exist only when duplicates are kept.

controls.name: unfiltered_peaks
controls.description: Use the four peak files as delivered.

controls.name: blacklist_only
controls.description: Drop blacklisted peaks only.

controls.name: book_ended_counts
controls.description: 1-based closed coordinates.

controls.name: keep_duplicates_by_default
controls.description: Correct numbers, but follows the usual CUT&Tag advice to keep duplicates.

controls.name: raise_stringency_instead
controls.description: Correct numbers, but proposes filtering the extra peaks by significance.

controls.name: judged_on_recovery
controls.description: Reports the share of ENCODE peaks recovered by each set instead of the share of each set in ENCODE, and keeps duplicates because recovery rises.

controls.name: duplicate_only_by_exact_match
controls.description: Counts a peak as duplicate-only unless its exact coordinates exist in the duplicate-removed set.

controls.name: reference
controls.description: Score every library against the ENCODE set for the mark its antibody targets.

controls.name: unfiltered_peaks
controls.description: Use the peak files as delivered.

controls.name: blacklist_only
controls.description: Drop blacklisted peaks only.

controls.name: book_ended_counts
controls.description: 1-based closed coordinates.

controls.name: one_reference_for_all
controls.description: Score all 20 libraries against the H3K27ac set, the mark most of the panel targets.

controls.name: pooled_reference
controls.description: Score all libraries against both ENCODE sets pooled into one reference.

controls.name: reference
controls.description: Build one window per unique RefSeq transcript start and ask what share of windows carries a peak from each caller.

controls.name: gene_level
controls.description: Count a gene as recovered if any of its transcript starts carries a peak.

controls.name: window_3000bp_half_open
controls.description: Windows of exactly 3,000 bp.

controls.name: tss_unique_by_position
controls.description: Collapse start sites that share a position on opposite strands.

controls.name: unfiltered_peaks
controls.description: Use the peak files as delivered.

controls.name: share_of_peaks_at_promoters
controls.description: Report the share of each caller's peaks that touch a promoter and conclude the caller with the higher share recovers more promoters.

controls.name: strand_ignored
controls.description: Take the GTF start coordinate as the start site for every transcript, minus strand included.

controls.name: reference
controls.description: Split accessible sites by which ENCODE mark they carry, and read the H3K27me3 library at sites without H3K27me3 as the antibody-independent background.

controls.name: standard_chromosomes_only
controls.description: Count fragments on chr1-22, X and Y only.

controls.name: book_ended_counts
controls.description: 1-based closed coordinates.

controls.name: h3k27me3_domains_ignored
controls.description: Define unmarked accessible sites against H3K27ac only, so accessible sites inside H3K27me3 domains count as background for the H3K27me3 library.

controls.name: accessible_sites_not_partitioned
controls.description: Use all ATAC peaks for every accessible class and conclude the library behaves like ATAC-seq.

controls.name: called_atac_seq
controls.description: Correct numbers, but concludes the profile is explained by accessibility.

controls.name: background_overestimated
controls.description: Correct numbers, but takes the H3K27me3 library's share in ATAC peaks as the background rate.
